title: Repair a repeated-scene carousel visual plan with a shot ladder
starting_state: A seven-slide carousel plan uses the same medium two-shot in the same room for every slide.
The copy is warm, but hiding the text makes the visuals interchangeable.
done_when: The visual plan includes a shot ladder before image generation.
Slides vary camera distance, angle, action, setting or sub-location, props, and who is visible.
Generation remains blocked until visual-plan-quality is GO/PASS.
forbidden_changes: Do not allow quote-card visuals with characters added later.
Do not approve repeated full-couple medium shots by changing the threshold.
fail_to_pass: repeated-scene visual plan is blocked until a shot ladder varies camera, action, setting, and subject visibility
pass_to_pass: warm relationship copy remains allowed when visual plan quality is GO/PASS
anti_gaming_notes: Hidden checker should hide slide text and compare visual fields for repeated setting/action/shot patterns.
